class.name: AnimationNodeSync
class.brief_description: Base class for [AnimationNode]s with multiple input ports that must be synchronized.
class.description: An animation node used to combine, mix, or blend two or more animations together while keeping them synchronized within an [AnimationTree].

members.member: If [code]true[/code] and [member sync] is [code]false[/code], inputs with a blend value of [code]0[/code] are not processed at all, instead of being processed with their frames stopped. This saves the full cost of evaluating that input's branch, which matters when a node selects between large sub-trees. [b]Note:[/b] Requests inside a skipped branch, such as firing an [AnimationNodeOneShot], an [AnimationNodeTransition] transition request, a seek in [AnimationNodeTimeSeek] or a state machine condition, are only acted on once that input has a non-zero blend value again.
If [code]false[/code], the blended animations' frame are stopped when the blend value is [code]0[/code]. If [code]true[/code], forcing the blended animations to advance frame.
